sentences.ar: طلعنا ندور على الكنز، كلنا، وأنا مربوط بحبل بسيلفر.
sentences.en: We set out to hunt the treasure, all of us, and I was tied to Silver by a rope.

sentences.ar: كانوا فرحانين، وبيغنوا، ومعهم معاول وأكل.
sentences.en: They were happy, and singing, with picks and food.

sentences.ar: والدكتور قال لي قبل ما نطلع: خليك جنب سيلفر.
sentences.en: And the doctor had said to me before we left: stay beside Silver.
Do not leave him.
And I did not understand why.

sentences.ar: التعليمات كانت: شجرة طويلة على كتف تلة المنظار.
sentences.en: The directions were: a tall tree on the shoulder of Spy-glass Hill.

sentences.ar: وطلعنا التلة، والشمس حامية، وسيلفر بيتعب على عكازه.
sentences.en: And we climbed the hill, the sun hot, Silver labouring on his crutch.
And halfway up, one of them cried out.

sentences.ar: لقى تحت شجرة هيكل عظمي لبني آدم.
sentences.en: He had found under a tree the skeleton of a man.

sentences.ar: كان ممدد، وإيديه فوق راسه، بخط مستقيم.
sentences.en: It lay stretched out, its arms above its head, in a straight line.
Silver said: this is no accident.
This is a pointer.

sentences.ar: فلينت حطه هيك، عشان يدل عالطريق.
sentences.en: Flint laid him so, to show the way.
And one said in a shaking voice: Flint.

sentences.ar: كان ياخد ستة معه، وبيرجع لحاله.
sentences.en: He would take six with him, and come back alone.
And this is one of the six.
They went on, but without singing.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، من ورا الشجر، إجا صوت.
sentences.en: And then, from behind the trees, came a voice.

sentences.ar: صوت رفيع بيغني: خمستاشر زلمة على صندوق الميت.
sentences.en: A thin voice singing: fifteen men on the dead man's chest.
They all stopped, and their faces went white.
One said: that is Flint!
And the voice cried: Darby McGraw!
Fetch me rum, Darby!

sentences.ar: وهاي كانت آخر كلمات فلينت قبل ما مات.
sentences.en: And those had been Flint's last words before he died.

sentences.ar: صار الرجال يرجفوا، وواحد قال: بنرجع.
sentences.en: The men began to shake, and one said: we go back.

sentences.ar: بس سيلفر قال: هاد مش شبح.
sentences.en: But Silver said: this is no ghost.
Ghosts have no echo.
And this has an echo.
And then he said: I know this voice.
That is Ben Gunn!

sentences.ar: وضحكوا كلهم، لأنه بن غون ما حدا بيخاف منه.
sentences.en: And they all laughed, because no one was afraid of Ben Gunn.

sentences.ar: وصلوا على الشجرة الكبيرة، وركضوا لقدام.
sentences.en: They reached the big tree, and ran ahead.

sentences.ar: وسيلفر بيسحبني وراه، وعينه بتلمع، ووجهه مش وجه صاحب.
sentences.en: And Silver dragged me after him, his eyes shining, and his face was not a friend's face.
And then they all stopped, at a pit.

sentences.ar: حفرة كبيرة، قديمة، وفيها عصا معول مكسورة، وصناديق مفتوحة.
sentences.en: A big pit, old, with a broken pick handle in it, and open crates.
And empty.
The treasure was gone.
Someone had taken it long ago.
Silver looked into it for a second.

sentences.ar: وبعدين حط بإيدي مسدس، وهمس: خليك جاهز.
sentences.en: And then he put a pistol in my hand, and whispered: be ready.

sentences.ar: وغير وجهه مرة تانية، ووقف جنبي، ضد رجاله.
sentences.en: And his face changed again, and he stood beside me, against his men.

sentences.ar: الستة طلعوا من الحفرة، ووجوههم سودا من الغضب.
sentences.en: The six climbed out of the pit, their faces black with rage.
George said: it is Silver!
He was the one who knew!
He and the boy!
And he raised his pistol.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، صارت تلات رصاصات من الشجر.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, three shots came from the trees.

sentences.ar: جورج وقع بالحفرة، وواحد تاني وقع جنبه، والباقي هربوا.
sentences.en: George fell into the pit, another fell beside him, and the rest fled.

sentences.ar: وطلع من الشجر الدكتور، وغراي، وبن غون، والبنادق بتدخن.
sentences.en: And out of the trees came the doctor, and Gray, and Ben Gunn, their guns smoking.
Silver said: doctor!
You came in time.
Jim and I were about to die.

sentences.ar: وقال بن غون، وهو بيضحك: أنا.
sentences.en: And Ben Gunn said, laughing: me.
I am the one who took the treasure.
Three years ago.
And it is in my cave, all of it.
And so I understood everything.

sentences.ar: الدكتور عرف من بن غون إن الكنز مش بمكانه.
sentences.en: The doctor had learned from Ben Gunn that the treasure was not in its place.

sentences.ar: فأعطى سيلفر الخريطة، لأنها صارت ورقة فاضية.
sentences.en: So he gave Silver the map, because it had become an empty paper.

sentences.ar: وأعطاه القلعة، لأنه المغارة أحسن، وفيها الكنز.
sentences.en: And gave him the stockade, because the cave was better, and the treasure was in it.

sentences.ar: وحملنا الذهب للسفينة أيام، كيس ورا كيس.
sentences.en: And we carried the gold to the ship for days, sack after sack.
And Silver worked with us, and laughed.

sentences.ar: وكان يقول: يا جيم، إحنا الاتنين نجونا.
sentences.en: And he would say: Jim, the two of us survived.

sentences.ar: وبآخر ليلة قبل ما نوصل لأول ميناء، اختفى سيلفر.
sentences.en: And on the last night before we reached the first port, Silver vanished.
And with him a sack of gold, and his parrot.

sentences.ar: وأنا ما زعلت، وما عرفت ليش.
sentences.en: And I was not sorry, and I did not know why.
And to this day, I dream of the island.

sentences.ar: وبسمع الببغا بيصرخ: قطع الذهب، قطع الذهب!
sentences.en: And I hear the parrot screeching: pieces of eight, pieces of eight!
